info.title: Agent Chat API
info.description: Versioned REST API for agent conversations, runs, approvals, media and credits. All `/api/v1` routes require a Clerk session token.

post.description: Submits a user turn (new chat when `chatId` is omitted) and returns the run to follow. The agent runs asynchronously: poll the run, use realtime, or receive webhooks.

post.description: Admits the message and dispatches a durable agent run. `attachmentIds` mixes new uploads and media-library items, in order. `interruptRunId` cancels the active run atomically. One active run per chat (409 otherwise). The first message of an untitled chat also starts automatic title generation (asynchronous; never overwrites a title set via PATCH).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per intentional request; a retry with the same key returns the original result.

post.description: Runs one media tool without the model, as a run of the chat: the input is validated against the tool's schema, credits are admitted and settled exactly as for agent-requested calls, and the result arrives as an assistant message (tool_use + tool_result). Poll the returned run. merge_videos accepts only the caller's own uploaded videos with a measured duration (≤ 300 s combined), estimated as ceil(ceil((40,000 + 10,000 × (n − 1)) × seconds / 60) × 1.3) credits; refusals: MERGE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED, MERGE_DURATION_UNKNOWN, MERGE_DURATION_LIMIT, INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.
